strategies.name: Naive Sequential All-Reduce Loop
strategies.desc: Direct translation of the reference code using 8 sequential all-reduce operations with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling/decoupling transformations. 8 all-reduce dispatches total. Represents the baseline: simplest structure, maximum dispatches, no optimization for communication-computation overlap or fusion.

strategies.name: Fused Coupling with Batched All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Precompute all 8 coupling transformations locally, stack the 8 transformed buffers into a single tensor of shape (8, W*S), dispatch one batched all-reduce, then locally apply all 8 decoupling transformations in sequence. 1 all-reduce dispatch with 8x payload size. Trades communication count for larger single message and sequential local compute phases.

strategies.name: Reduce-Scatter + All-Gather Pipeline
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter (producing local shard) followed by all-gather (broadcasting result). Apply coupling/decoupling only to local shard between phases, leveraging smaller intermediate payloads. 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG). Reduces per-rank memory pressure and enables potential pipelining of scatter/gather phases across stages.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Reduction
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node all-reduce (partial sum across cores_per_device or devices per node), apply coupling transformation once per node, then inter-node all-reduce, followed by broadcast and final decoupling. Approximately 16-24 dispatches depending on hierarchy depth. Optimizes for network topology by reducing cross-node traffic volume.

strategies.name: Ring-Based Incremental Aggregation
strategies.desc:
Implement custom ring-allreduce pattern using point-to-point send/recv primitives (or all-to-all with structured indexing) where each rank incrementally accumulates partial sums and applies coupling transformations in-flight during ring traversal phases. 8 * (2*W-1) message dispatches in worst case, but messages are S-sized instead of W*S. Trades dispatch count for dramatically smaller per-message payload and potential latency hiding.
